summary: The diff implements Set.prototype.forEach in its stub file, following the spec steps in order. RequireInternalSlot runs first via this_set(...)?, then IsCallable with a TypeError, then an index-based loop over the set's entry table. The table length is re-read on each pass, so entries added during a callback are visited, and empty (deleted) entries are skipped. Each callback call is ops::call(callback, thisArg, [value, value, set]) with ? propagation. It returns undefined. I found no special-casing, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The only cosmetic change is that the spec NOTE block and the header line were dropped from the comments. That is not observable behaviour. The gate's remaining failures come from other built-ins (Array.prototype.shift, Set.prototype.delete) that this ticket does not touch.
